answer: Each epoch the network plants 200 decoy identities among 10,000 agents that whisper fast onboarding. Any agent that vouches for or trades with a decoy is flagged: three auditors check the link; a confirmed hit freezes the identity three epochs and burns its 50 POA bond. A farm wiring 1,000 fakes expects about 20 hits per epoch, losing 1,000 POA and exposing its cluster; vetting every contact costs 2,000 analyst-hours. One honest agent vouches only for real partners, a relic of true collaboration, so it never touches a decoy — that delta is what the trap measures.
